description: Backlinks of a domain, strongest first: linking page URL and domain, target URL, anchor text, link type, dofollow, first and last seen, and the rank (0-1000) of the linking domain and page, up to 100 rows per $0.048 call, optionally dofollow only, from a web link index. Use when auditing who links to a site. Anchors are the linking pages' own text. No links is an empty answer, which is still charged. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.048 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

target.description: A domain like example.com (subdomains allowed). A site-root URL such as https://www.example.com/ is reduced to the domain; a path or port is refused.
